description: DaVita Inc. is a leading healthcare provider focused on transforming care delivery to improve quality of life for patients globally, and as a comprehensive kidney care provider it has been a leader in clinical quality and innovation for more than two decades. Its businesses include its U.S. dialysis operations, U.S. integrated kidney care, international operations and a few other ancillary services and investments outside those operations, collectively referred to as its ancillary services, along with a separate corporate administrative support function that supports the U.S. dialysis business and those ancillary services, and its patient-centric care model leverages its platform of kidney care.
